verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI documents filter-based bulk data operations: it can delete data and add or remove tags from all data matching a filter, and it can export or query data with SQL/MQL. Fleet-level breadth is less concrete, since fragments and OTA updates are mentioned only briefly, with no explicit description of acting on many machines or resources in one operation. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions across machines or resources (for example, applying config or commands fleet-wide), detail on scale and limits of bulk operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
